title: AlignFace: Human-Aligned Face Similarity Metric with Interpretable Concept Relations
abstract: arXiv:2608.14130v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Computer vision models for generated facial content, such as face editing and privacy protection, increasingly affect people, requiring similarity metrics that serve as faithful proxies for human perception. While perceptual evaluation has progressed from signal-based heuristics to representation-based metrics, current approaches are limited to behavioral modeling without cognitive alignment. They rely on implicit and spurious relations while assuming a universal observer, failing to account for inherent variations across diverse human populations. This leads to inaccurate evaluative models of stakeholders and misleading guidance for generative model debugging. Rather than treating perception as a black box, we leverage scientific findings from cognitive psychology of human face similarity perception: dependence on facial featural and configural attributes, nonlinear psychophysical response scaling, and own-group biases. translated_title: AlignFace：具有可解释概念关系的人类对齐面部相似度度量
translated_abstract: 针对生成面部内容（如面部编辑和隐私保护）的计算机视觉模型日益影响人们，需要能够忠实代理人类感知的相似度度量。虽然感知评估已从基于信号的启发式方法发展到基于表示的方法，但当前方法局限于行为建模，缺乏认知对齐。它们依赖隐性和虚假的关系，同时假设一个普遍观察者，未能考虑不同人群间的固有差异，导致对利益相关者的评估模型不准确，并给生成模型调试带来误导性指导。我们不将感知视为黑箱，而是利用人类面部相似度感知的认知心理学科学发现：依赖于面部特征和构型属性、非线性心理物理响应缩放以及同群体偏差。我们引入了t（此处截断，但基于上下文，可能指一种新方法或模型）。
tldr: 本文提出AlignFace，一种基于认知心理学原理的人类对齐面部相似度度量，通过可解释的概念关系建模，考虑了特征/构型属性、非线性响应和同群体偏差，以更准确地代理人类感知。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces AlignFace, a human-aligned face similarity metric leveraging cognitive psychology principles with interpretable concept relations, accounting for featural/configural attributes, nonlinear responses, and own-group biases for faithful human perception proxy.
